# uapi_cron_job (Resource)

One line of the root crontab (`/etc/crontabs/root`). Every other line stays as it is, so the lines that packages add survive. There is no per-job update: changing the schedule or the command replaces the job.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uapi_cron_job" "nightly_reboot" {
  schedule = "30 4 * * sun"
  command  = "/sbin/reboot"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command` (String) Shell command run as root. Must not contain `#` or control characters, start or end with whitespace, or end with `\`: crond would cut, strip or join them, and the entry would read back different.
- `schedule` (String) Five fields separated by single spaces: minute 0-59, hour 0-23, day 1-31, month 1-12 or jan-dec, weekday 0-6 or sun-sat. Each takes lists, ranges and `*`, and a `/step` after `*` or a range. uapi refuses what OpenWrt's busybox crond does not run as written: weekday 7, `@daily`-style schedules, and `*/N` in the day field (write `1-31/N`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable id: sha256 prefix of `<schedule> <command>`. A change to either gives a new id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by id (the sha256 prefix of "<schedule> <command>" that uapi assigns).
# List the ids with GET /system/cron_jobs. Import recovers schedule and command.
terraform import uapi_cron_job.nightly_reboot 0a1b2c3d4e5f
```
